decision: Adopt a change only if it finds more at-risk patients in the test group, finds no fewer in the learning group, and does so in all 4 random test groups. Otherwise keep the current scoring.

ideas.label: Give a weak heart more points
ideas.detail: Heart pumping (ejection fraction) below 35%: 2 points → 3 points

ideas.label: Add a point for patients 80 or older
ideas.detail: Age 80 or older: 1 extra point, on top of the point for 70 or older

ideas.label: Give weak kidneys more points
ideas.detail: Kidney function (serum creatinine) above 1.5 mg/dL: 2 points → 3 points

ideas.label: Add a point for low blood sodium
ideas.detail: Blood sodium below 135 mEq/L: 0 points → 1 point

ideas.label: Count more hearts as weak
ideas.detail: Weak heart cut-off: pumping below 35% → below 40% (still 2 points)

ideas.label: Count fewer hearts as weak
ideas.detail: Weak heart cut-off: pumping below 35% → below 30% (still 2 points)

ideas.label: Count more kidneys as weak
ideas.detail: Weak kidney cut-off: creatinine above 1.5 → above 1.3 mg/dL (still 2 points)

ideas.label: Count fewer kidneys as weak
ideas.detail: Weak kidney cut-off: creatinine above 1.5 → above 1.8 mg/dL (still 2 points)
